title: Rapid-Fire Rebound-and-Shoot
description: Two players share one basket, each rebounding the other's miss or make and resetting as fast as possible for a high-volume shooting burst.

content.objective: Maximise the number of quality shots taken in a short, high-tempo burst.
content.setup: Two shooters share one basket with two balls, each shooting from their own spot.
instructions: Both shooters shoot continuously, rebounding their own ball after each attempt.
Keep both feet set and reload as quickly as possible after every shot.
Run the burst for 30 to 45 seconds, then switch shooting spots.
Count total makes across three bursts to track progress over time.
coachingPoints: Don't sacrifice form for speed — a fast, broken shot doesn't help.
Keep the rebound-to-release transition as smooth as possible.
Stay in the same shooting spot for the whole burst.
commonMistakes: Rushing so much that the base and follow-through break down.
Chasing a long rebound into the other shooter's space.
Rushing the release instead of trusting the mechanics.
content.safety: Keep enough separation between the two shooters' landing areas.
